title: Arbor Day.
bodyText: The first Friday in November shall be known as Arbor Day, provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-7]  Arbor Day.  The first Friday in November shall be known as Arbor Day, provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 1979, c 17, §1]
